controls.title: AI system impact assessment process
controls.requirement: The organization shall establish a process for AI system impact assessment.
controls.implementation: Product team maintains a formal impact assessment using Trust & Safety templates covering ethical, legal, and safety risks before release.

controls.title: AI system operation and monitoring
controls.requirement: The organization shall monitor AI system operation.
controls.implementation: Prometheus metrics and Splunk/Sentry sinks are configured; OTel export tracked in LCORE-322.

controls.title: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.requirement: The organization shall determine external and internal issues.
controls.implementation: The organization shall determine external and internal issues relevant to its purpose.

controls.title: AI system security
controls.requirement: The organization shall address AI system security.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.implementation: System cards published for in-scope products.
